description:
Read the bodies of 1 to 20 Interoperability messages by header ID, such as the ids iris_message_search returns: use it after a search to see what a message carried. Returns one item per ID, in request order (a repeated ID gives a repeated item): the body class and ID, the body kind and the body rendered by kind. An HL7 v2 body is shown as ER7 text (format er7). An XML virtual document is shown as XML (xml). A persistent object is shown as JSON (json): its JSON export when its class extends %JSON.Adaptor, otherwise a dump of its public properties, where a character stream shows its text and a binary stream its class and size, and a list or array is its count. A stream or a stream container is shown as text (text), and so is the value of a header with no body class. Any other body (another virtual document such as X12 or EDIFACT, a class that is not compiled, a body that no longer opens) is shown as its class and ID with a reason in notShown. A header that does not exist is {id, found: false, error}.

maxChars (default 10000, max 1048576) caps the text shown per body: a longer text is cut, with truncated: true. It caps the output only. An XML body is serialized whole before it is cut, and so is a JSON export, but a character stream in a property dump is read only up to the read limit. An HL7 v2 body is read only whole: IRIS never cuts one, so a body longer than 65536 characters is not shown, and under the allow policy a larger maxChars (at most 1048576) reads a longer one.

PHI data policy (IRIS_DATA_POLICY, set per profile; default redact). block withholds every body. redact shows an HL7 v2 body only after a reviewed keep-list redaction (a field nobody reviewed is replaced by ***), complete or not at all, and withholds every other kind of body and any HL7 v2 body longer than 65536 characters, each with a reason in notShown; the content of a withheld body is never read out of IRIS. allow shows bodies as stored. dataPolicy can only tighten the profile's policy: a looser value is ignored and dataPolicyClamped: true says so. Each body carries bodyPolicy (redacted, blocked or none) and the result carries dataPolicy {policy, redacted, blocked} with the counts. The policy reduces exposure; it is not a compliance certification. Text is sanitized after redaction: CR and CRLF become LF and other C0 control characters and DEL are replaced by U+FFFD.

A namespace without Interoperability returns notApplicable: true with a reason, not an error.

GOVERNANCE - a read, enabled by default (and enabled under the read-only preset). An operator can restrict it with IRIS_GOVERNANCE, e.g. {"global": {"iris_message_body": false}}.

dataPolicy.description: A data policy for this call: block, redact or allow. It can only tighten the profile's policy; a looser one is ignored and reported as dataPolicyClamped.

headerIds.description: Header IDs to read (1-20 positive integers, number or string of digits), such as the id values iris_message_search returns.

maxChars.description: Most characters of text shown per body (default 10000, max 1048576). An output cap: the body is read whole first (HL7 v2) or serialized whole (XML, JSON export); a character stream in a property dump is read only up to the read limit. Under allow it also raises the HL7 v2 read limit above 65536.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to operate on a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_message_body
title: Read Interoperability Message Bodies
